reports.title: MFL player ranks
reports.how: MFL's player rank, not the app's model. Up means last week's rank minus this week's rank is positive; down means negative. A last-week rank of zero means MFL supplied no previous rank. New this week is MFL's new-entry flag; no earlier rank is shown.

reports.title: Average draft position
reports.source: Source: MFL-wide · many leagues, not this league
reports.how: MFL-wide across many leagues, not this league. All draft periods are requested, since the default period can have no picks in season. The bar runs from the lowest to highest pick reported, with the average marked; it is not a confidence interval or a grade.

reports.title: Average auction value
reports.source: Source: MFL-wide · many leagues, not this league
reports.how: MFL-wide across many leagues, not this league. Values are MFL's auction-budget shares, expressed as percent, not this league's dollars. No dollar conversion is made. The bar runs from the smallest to largest share reported, with the average marked; it is not a confidence interval or a grade. Outliers above 100% are shown as supplied, not clipped.
